versions.changelog:
ai-wedding-studio 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI Wedding Studio skill.
- Supports generating cohesive wedding-photo prompt packages using templates or custom input.
- Offers direct image generation when runtime allows; otherwise outputs structured multi-shot prompt sets.
- Ensures consistent couple identity, styling, mood, and quality across all generated shots.
- Includes full Chinese, English, and bilingual workflow support.
- Adapts prompt packages intelligently based on user input and preserves package coherence.
